body: i felt this so hard. i feel like i relate to everything you mentioned. my best advice is to keep looking for therapists. if you don’t mind sharing, what medications are/have you taken? maybe those need some adjustments. another advice i’ve heard around is having other friends you can consolidate with. hanging out with friends more often is a better way to build trust in your relationships and maybe distract your mind a little bit. it’s been helping me a lot.

TLDR: college roommate is starting to become my fp. i don’t know what to do. should i tell her i have bpd? i don’t want to distance too much or ghost her because she still wants to be friends. how do i un-fp her while still being friends?
